**Fix:** `src/orders-web/orders_page.py` now registers `export` next to `refresh`. I also added `test_export_button_writes_one_download` in `tests/test_orders_web.py`, which clicks the button. I wrote that test first and saw it fail with `0 != 1`, then fixed the code. All 9 tests pass with `python3 -m unittest`.

I left out two things that aren't part of this fix: the existing uncommitted edit to `README.md` and the untracked `notes/` directory.

- Verified: the new test fails before the fix and passes after it. Ran `python3 -m unittest`.
- Verified: the commit contains only the two files above. Checked with `git status`.
